calibration.notes: This task must not be treated as a calibrated leaderboard item until an independently designed candidate reaches 100/100 under the exact fixed controls with numerical margin.

purpose: Human cross-check of the selected candidate in Ansys Electronics Desktop.
verification_steps: Open project_file and select the named HFSS design.
Compare model dimensions with design_parameters below.
Compare Setup1, Sweep1, EfficiencySweep, radiation region, port, and InfiniteSphere1 with simulation_control.
Plot dB(S(1,1)) on Setup1:Sweep1 and compare resonance, minimum S11, and contiguous threshold bandwidth.
At Setup1:LastAdaptive, open the InfiniteSphere1 Antenna Parameters report and compare dB(PeakGain).
Export dB(S(1,1)) from Setup1:Sweep1. Separately export InfiniteSphere1 RadiationEfficiency from the discrete Setup1:EfficiencySweep; treat it as a linear ratio, not a percentage or dB value.

Inside the measured-resonance window, linearly interpolate RadiationEfficiency to the Sweep1 frequency grid without extrapolation. Compute clamp(RadiationEfficiency * (1 - 10^(dB(S11)/10)), 0, 1) at each Sweep1 sample, average, and multiply by 100 to compare total_efficiency_mean_percent.

derived_metric_formulas.interpolated_radiation_efficiency_ratio: linear interpolation of Setup1:EfficiencySweep RadiationEfficiency onto the Setup1:Sweep1 grid; no extrapolation
derived_metric_formulas.total_efficiency_mean_percent: 100 * arithmetic_mean(single_port_total_efficiency_ratio on Sweep1 samples within measured resonance +/- configured half span)

substrate_width_mm.description: Overall substrate and ground-plane width along x.

substrate_length_mm.description: Overall substrate and ground-plane length along y.

patch_width_mm.description: Rectangular radiating patch width before the centered inset notch.

inset_depth_mm.description: Distance that the feed line penetrates into the patch from its radiating edge.

inset_gap_mm.description: Gap on each side of the inset feed line.

substrate_material.description: Human-readable material label; numeric properties below are authoritative.

substrate_relative_permittivity.description: Linear dimensionless relative permittivity used by HFSS.

substrate_loss_tangent.description: Linear dimensionless dielectric loss tangent used by HFSS.

sweep_start.description: Read-only lower edge of the evaluation sweep.

sweep_stop.description: Read-only upper edge of the evaluation sweep.

sweep_points.description: Read-only number of frequency samples in the interpolating sweep.

start.description: Lower edge of the discrete radiation-efficiency sweep; it matches the main evaluation sweep so reasonably detuned candidates remain measurable.

stop.description: Upper edge of the discrete radiation-efficiency sweep; it matches the main evaluation sweep so reasonably detuned candidates remain measurable.

points.description: Number of solved frequencies with saved solution and radiation fields, preserving the original 10 MHz spacing over the wider range.

bandwidth_s11_threshold.description: 20*log10(|S11|) threshold used for contiguous impedance bandwidth.

total_efficiency_window_half_span.description: Half-width around the measured resonant frequency used to average single-port total efficiency.

air_margin_xy.description: Absolute radiation-region offset on each x/y side.

air_above.description: Absolute radiation-region offset above the patch.

air_below.description: Absolute radiation-region offset below the ground plane.

metric_errors.total_efficiency: CandidateMetricUnavailableError: 总体效率窗口超出 S11 扫频范围，禁止外推: window=2.575-2.625 GHz

resonant_frequency.semantics: Frequency of the minimum sampled/interpolated dB(S(1,1)) within the fixed 2.30-2.60 GHz sweep. Values are linear GHz, not angular frequency.

minimum_s11.semantics: Minimum of 20*log10(|S11|) over the fixed sweep. More negative is better; this is dB, not a positive return-loss magnitude and not linear |S11|.

impedance_bandwidth.semantics: Width of the contiguous region containing the minimum-S11 resonance where 20*log10(|S11|) <= -10 dB, with linear interpolation at threshold crossings.

peak_gain.semantics: Maximum HFSS dB(PeakGain) from the InfiniteSphere1 Antenna Parameters report at Setup1:LastAdaptive (2.45 GHz). This is logarithmic dBi, not linear gain and not realized gain.

band_average_total_efficiency.semantics: Arithmetic mean on the 1 MHz Setup1:Sweep1 grid over measured resonance +/- 25 MHz of clamp(interp(RadiationEfficiency from the discrete Setup1:EfficiencySweep) * (1 - 10^(dB(S11)/10)), 0, 1), expressed as a linear percentage. Interpolation is allowed only inside the discrete efficiency sweep; extrapolation is forbidden. HFSS RadiationEfficiency is treated as a linear ratio even when numerical error makes it slightly greater than 1. This is single-port total efficiency, including mismatch loss, and is not in dB.
